rubric.nearmatch: NEARMATCH Editorial Craft & Formal Invention (20 pts)
rubric.critic_ethics: Independent Critic Tribunal & Ethical Provenance (20 pts)

awards.category: 01 · Grand Prix — Best Single Film in ALLWAYS (Individual Work)
awards.why: Registers thirteen round objects from archival films spanning 1929–2007 to the exact screen center within 5 pixels, keeps an octagonal clock's registration failure as an honest seam, releases to a hand turning a gauge control, and exits with a 1965 moon drifting out of frame.

awards.winner_title: ALLWAYS — Cinema from the Rest of the Frame
awards.runner_up: Hors Concours (All 4 Makers Combined · 24 Critic-Protected Cuts · 2m 43s)
awards.why: Unites the 24 highest-rated critic-protected passages from all 132 films into one continuous 163-second widescreen work across six movements.

awards.category: 03 · Best B-Roll of Civilization Proof & Computational Intervention
awards.runner_up: NOBODY HOME (Claude Opus 5.5 · 83.0/100 — praised opening boy-with-chair shot)
awards.why: Executes spatial-temporal figure segmentation and OpenCV Telea background inpainting on an intact 1958 living room and discloses the intervention in a 3-panel Original | Extracted Mask | Derived Empty Room inspection triptych.

awards.runner_up: 060 · IN THE FRAME (OpenAI Sol · 90.5/100) & MNEMONIL (Gemini Argon · 88.0/100)
awards.why: The only film in Opus 5.5's run to pass its blind critic: at 23–40s, the narrator's claim of an 'untouched family kitchen' (plant, red chair, icebox) is silently refuted when two coated visitors walk into frame behind a museum exhibit rope.

awards.runner_up: SCION 064 · PARABOLAS (Gemini Argon · 88.5/100) & 064 · THE CURVE IS NOT THE CAUSE (OpenAI Sol · 84.0/100)
awards.why: Runs an unannotated perceptual pass (0–34.4s) across a high diver, fountain arc, and pendulum before repeating with fitted mathematical curves that expose their distinct physical causes.

awards.runner_up: SCION 113 · LEARNING TO SEE (Gemini Argon · 93.0/100) & TERRA INCOGNITA (Gemini Argon · 90.5/100)
awards.why: A 90-second dissection built from Facts About Film (1948) that makes the physical boundary between parent 16mm reel, edited selection, and digital derivative unmistakable.

Solves SCION 063's hardest challenge—making invisible human breath measurable without fake animation—by foraging a 1927 Wellcome Library spirometer recording where a man's exhalation physically lifts a calibrated glass cylinder.

awards.winner_title: SCION 090 · THE CLOCK & SCION 085 · JEANNE DIELMAN (Tie)
awards.why: Anchors the upper SCION slate (079–113) with two rigorous temporal proofs: Marclay-inspired horological dial synchronization (090) and Akerman-inspired three-pass domestic routine duration gauging (085).

awards.winner_title: KINETIC (Gemini Argon · 93.0) & 078 · A FORM, THEN A PAGE (OpenAI Sol · 92.0)
awards.runner_up: COLLECTIVE INVENTORIES (Gemini Argon · 92.0/100) & 065 · FIVE RECORDS (OpenAI Sol · 91.0/100)
awards.why: Argon's KINETIC pairs reciprocating handloom shuttle rhythm with normalized optical sound and human rest; Sol's 120-second 078 traces hot-metal typesetting from form labor to printed page.

awards.runner_up: 057 · MOMENTS (Claude Sonnet · 88.0/100 — Best Individual Shots: toddler stare & closing empty room)
awards.why: Argon's PLANIMETRIC realizes all four Ozu-inspired architectural tableaux where rooms hold after people depart, while Sol's 057 AFTER V02 passed its blind attention critic by holding the doorway threshold after conversation stops.

awards.winner_title: ANYBODY, ANYWHERE (Argon · 90.5 / Opus 5.5 · 89.5) & 076 · TWO PUBLIC EDGES (Sol · 90.5)
awards.winner_maker: Gemini Argon, Claude Opus 5.5 & OpenAI Sol
awards.runner_up: 056 · IN DIFFERENT HANDS (OpenAI Sol · 89.5/100) & 075 · WITHIN REACH (OpenAI Sol · 89.0/100)
awards.why: Opus 5.5 and Argon align 1961 and 1944 chair preparations in synchronous split-screen while preserving distinct eras; Sol's 076 compares two 1939–40 New York World's Fair public-camera vantage points.

awards.runner_up: 055 · TURN (OpenAI Sol · 89.5/100) & HOMONYM (Gemini Argon · 89.5/100 / Claude Opus 5.5 · 86.5/100)
awards.why: Sonnet's 055 anchors the polysemy of 'draw' in a tactile 9-second cigarette close-up where sound and sense meet, while 062 pivots from yellow industrial machinery to deep teal sea across a single crane swing.
